[[File:MidwifeDroid_SWCTP.png|thumb|right|250px|A midwife droid holding a newborn Leia Skywalker.]]

'''Midwife droids''' were a type of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] developed to assist [[Doctor/Legends|obstetricians]] of varying [[Species/Legends|species]] in delivering infants. These droids were most often created in the image of a [[Gender/Legends|female]] of the species, and had calming personalities, a non- threatening aspect and had soothing voices. The [[Limb/Legends|limbs]] of the droid were designed to help ease the mother's discomfort and pain, and provide support for the newborn. The main body of the midwife droid was wrapped in specialized materials that could be heated to comfort the baby. A [[Polis Massa/Legends|Polis Massan]] [[Chroon-Tan B-Machine/Legends|Chroon-Tan]] midwife droid delivered [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Skywalker]].
